misprints.note: Under Höna the genitive ending is printed without its iota.
The opening parenthesis is missing in the print.
No breathing is visible on ακοῆς.
The headword Höstväder is printed twice. The first entry (autumn sowing/seed) probably means Höstsäd.
A comma is printed before c), and before 4) after ἐπιστέλλειν. Kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The print shows 'hörsamına', which is likely a broken m. I kept hörsamma.
The OCR read the small letter as ἶ. The glyph's hook matches the ἰ in ἰῶτα, so I transcribed it as ἰ (smooth breathing, no accent). It could also be a plain ι.
There is a stray vertical mark '|' before 'gå' in the print, probably a raised spacing quad. I removed it.
